purpose: Manual visual-regression cases for source-led prototype rendering.

cases.title: Modern prototype changes finish, not the Lakeside elevation
cases.prompt: Photorealistic architectural render. Use the reference only for its modern material palette, facade finish, paving, planting and lighting. Preserve the source elevation, roof, openings, terrace, left service block, right wing, camera angle and framing exactly.
mustKeep: left service block with its door and horizontal window
covered terrace, glass guardrail and right-side wing
mustNeverAdd: a porch, classical columns or a new balcony
relocated, enlarged or replaced doors and windows
the prototype building's viewpoint or layout

cases.title: Pitched-roof references cannot redesign the Lakeside elevation
cases.prompt: Photorealistic architectural render. Borrow only compatible colours, wall finishes, paving, landscape and exterior lighting from the prototypes. Keep the source elevation's flat roofs, volumes, openings, terrace, camera and framing exactly as drawn.
mustKeep: flat rooflines rather than the references' pitched roofs
the source terrace instead of a front porch
mustNeverAdd: gables, red tiled pitched roofs or roof dormers
a portico, columns, arches or a new front porch
a prototype window, door, massing or camera angle
